name: neuradigi-commit
description: AI-generated Conventional Commits messages from your staged diff. One-click sparkle in the Source Control panel. Pick your engine: Claude CLI (cloud, best quality) or Ollama (local, free, offline) — your data, your choice.

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect: pick whichever is installed; if both are available, ask once and remember the choice.
Claude CLI (cloud) — best quality. Requires the Claude Code CLI installed and authenticated.
Ollama (local) — free and offline. Requires Ollama running on your machine.
neuradigiCommit.backend.description: Which backend to use when generating commit messages.

neuradigiCommit.cliPath.description: Path to the Claude CLI executable.

neuradigiCommit.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama HTTP server.

neuradigiCommit.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model to use. Pull it first with `ollama pull <model>`. Recommended: `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` (small, fast) or `qwen2.5-coder:7b` (better quality, more RAM).

neuradigiCommit.prompt.default: You are a non-interactive commit message generator. Read the staged git diff below and output exactly one Conventional Commits message describing it. STRICT RULES: output ONLY the commit message; no preamble, no explanation, no code fences, no markdown, no questions, no acknowledgements. Format: type(optional-scope): subject under 72 chars; add a blank line and a wrapped body only if the change is non-trivial. Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore. If the diff is empty, whitespace-only, or you cannot determine its purpose, output exactly: chore: minor changes
neuradigiCommit.prompt.description: Prompt sent to the AI engine (used by both Claude and Ollama).

neuradigiCommit.extraArgs.description: Extra args to pass to the Claude CLI (e.g. ["--model", "claude-sonnet-4-6"]).
